record.chaining: Nominally unlimited capacity, but unverified. Upload and pricing endpoints returned HTTP 503 on 2026-10-21.
record.limits_note: Unverified. The landing page states unlimited, but /datafiles/new, /plan, /faq and /about all return 503 '現在システムメンテナンス中'. Do not treat the unlimited claim as usable until the upload path answers.
record.reliability_note: This is the classic Japanese small-host failure mode: the marketing page stays up and the actual service is down. Every functional URL 503'd while the root page served fine, which is exactly the 'never trust HTTP 200' trap in reverse. Here the 200 was the brochure and the 503 was the service.

evidence.proved: '容量無制限のファイル転送を無料にて提供します', 'データ送信量の制限はありません'
probe: GET /datafiles/new -> 503, /plan -> 503, /faq -> 503, /about -> 503, body title '八八ファイル便 - 現在システムメンテナンス中'
